correct_completion: the team worked through the night.
full_sentence: The deadline approaching, the team worked through the night.
acceptable_variants: the team stayed late into the night.
the team kept working until dawn.

options.text: the team working through the night.
options.why_wrong: Two participles appear in a row, so the absolute phrase and the main clause are not properly separated; the main clause needs a finite verb.
An infinitive cannot serve as the main clause after an absolute phrase, so the sentence is left incomplete.

options.text: the team worked through the night.
the team has worked through the night.
options.why_wrong: The present perfect introduces a finite verb tied to a different time frame, which does not fit the simultaneous action expressed by the absolute phrase.

grammar_focus: Absolute (verbless/participial) clauses followed by a main clause with its own subject
explanation: An absolute phrase such as 'The deadline approaching' has its own subject and is followed by a main clause with a finite verb, here 'the team worked'.
translation: Com o prazo se aproximando, a equipe trabalhou noite adentro.
